maintenance_led.reason: Sells Vafseo and Auryxia, prescription drugs for kidney disease; new prescriptions, not repair or servicing of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Auryxia and Vafseo are used mainly by dialysis and CKD patients, largely covered by Medicare and Medicaid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by developing and selling its own drugs; the Keryx deal was a single large acquisition.

mission_critical.reason: Prescribers can switch patients to alternative anemia or phosphate-binder drugs; the cost of switching is modest.

notes: Public funding share is inferred from the patient mix, not stated on the website text.
